rows.semanticAssessment: A credible alteration is an input, not the defined manufactured intervention. Discovery, selection, message and product handoffs remain separate.

Altered sequence can nominate a peptide while expression, processing, display and recognition remain distinct. The index word most is not adopted as a measured attrition rate; these are conditional gates, not a frequency estimate.
HLA displays peptide and a conventional alpha-beta receptor recognises the combined surface. The qualification avoids extending this route to every T-cell family.
Initial priming, naturally presenting tumour recognition and durable clinical benefit are different measurements; blood reactivity alone does not bridge them.

Messenger RNA has a construct specification distinct from its delivery formulation. Correct identity/purity or release cannot rescue an unsuitable target or establish presentation, recognition or benefit. The construct owner remains frozen and unintegrated.
Blood-cell expansion does not demonstrate recurrence prevention. Dose, route, cadence, combinations, duration, monitoring and stopping belong to the specified protocol.

All eight diagram jobs remain: recognition basis, tumour-normal comparison, HLA/presentation, candidate selection/testing, antigen instructions, manufacture/release, protocol dosing/monitoring, and clinical comparison. The map is a reading framework of dependencies, not a guaranteed or strictly timed biological chain. Both source diagram themes were freshly viewed.
